poulter <- list(

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. Preparar lookups y clases válidas (SOLO para Tree)
# =============================================================================
valid_classes <- as.integer(names(poulter))

pft_names <- c("Tree")  # <--- SOLO Tree

# Inicializar lookups SOLO para Tree
lookups <- setNames(lapply(pft_names, function(p) rep(0, 256)), pft_names)

get_frac <- function(lst, key) if (key %in% names(lst)) lst[[key]] else 0

for (lc_class in names(poulter)) {
  idx <- as.integer(lc_class) + 1
  frac_list <- poulter[[lc_class]]
  for (pft in pft_names) {
    lookups[[pft]][idx] <- get_frac(frac_list, pft)
  }
}

# Verificar que Tree tenga valores > 0 en las clases correctas
cat("Clases con Tree > 0:\n")
tree_classes <- which(lookups[["Tree"]] > 0) - 1  # -1 porque R es 1-indexed
print(tree_classes)

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. Función de reclasificación (SOLO Tree)
# =============================================================================
reclassify_pft <- function(raster_obj, lookup, valid_classes) {
  from_to <- cbind(valid_classes, lookup[valid_classes + 1])
  classify(raster_obj, rcl = from_to, others = NA)
}
```




```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 4. Función para reducir resolución
# =============================================================================
agregar_raster <- function(raster_obj, factor, fun = "modal") {
  aggregate(raster_obj, fact = factor, fun = modal, na.rm = TRUE)
}

```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5. Lista de archivos (1992-1993 para prueba)
# =============================================================================
esa_filepath <- list.files(
  path = "C:/Copernicus_Land_Cover/LATAM_LCCS_1992_to_2022/",
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

esa_filepath_test <- esa_filepath[grepl("-(1992|1993)-", esa_filepath)]

cat("\n📁 Archivos seleccionados:\n")
print(basename(esa_filepath_test))

n_years <- length(esa_filepath_test)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. Mostrar configuración
# =============================================================================
cat(paste0("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
cat("⚙️  CONFIGURACIÓN ACTUAL\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("  PFT objetivo        : 🌳 Tree\n")
cat("  Reducir resolución  :", ifelse(REDUCIR_RESOLUCION, "✅ SÍ", "❌ NO"), "\n")
if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
  cat("  Factor agregación   :", FACTOR_AGREGACION, "\n")
  cat("  Resolución aprox.   :", 
      round(0.002777 * FACTOR_AGREGACION * 110, 2), "km\n")
}
cat("  Años a procesar     :", n_years, "\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 7. PROCESAR AÑOS (SOLO Tree)
# =============================================================================
cat("📊 Procesando", n_years, "años...\n")

# Inicializar acumulador SOLO para Tree
sum_tree <- NULL

for (i in seq_along(esa_filepath_test)) {
  year <- as.numeric(str_extract(basename(esa_filepath_test[i]), "\\d{4}"))
  cat("\n  📅 Procesando año", year, "...\n")
  
  # Leer raster
  r <- rast(esa_filepath_test[i], subds = "lccs_class")
  
  cat("     Resolución original:", res(r)[1], "° x", res(r)[2], "°\n")
  cat("     Dimensiones originales:", nrow(r), "x", ncol(r), "\n")
  
  # Reducir resolución si está activado
  if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
    cat("     🔽 Reduciendo resolución (factor =", FACTOR_AGREGACION, ")...\n")
    r <- agregar_raster(r, FACTOR_AGREGACION, fun = "modal")
    cat("     Resolución agregada:", res(r)[1], "° x", res(r)[2], "°\n")
    cat("     Dimensiones agregadas:", nrow(r), "x", ncol(r), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("     ✅ Usando resolución original\n")
  }
  
  # Reclasificar a Tree PFT
  cat("     Extrayendo fracción de Tree...\n")
  tree_i <- reclassify_pft(r, lookups[["Tree"]], valid_classes)
  
  # Acumular
  if (is.null(sum_tree)) {
    sum_tree <- tree_i
  } else {
    sum_tree <- sum_tree + tree_i
  }
  
  rm(r, tree_i)
  gc()
}
```




```{r}


# =============================================================================
# 8. Calcular promedio de Tree
# =============================================================================
cat("\n📊 Calculando promedio de Tree (1992-1993)...\n")

tree_mean <- sum_tree / n_years
names(tree_mean) <- "Tree"

# =============================================================================
# 9. VERIFICACIÓN
# =============================================================================
cat(paste0("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
cat("✅ VERIFICACIÓN DE RESULTADOS\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

# Estadísticas de Tree
mean_val <- global(tree_mean, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
min_val <- global(tree_mean, "min", na.rm = TRUE)
max_val <- global(tree_mean, "max", na.rm = TRUE)
na_count <- global(tree_mean, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x)))

cat("🌳 Tree PFT (1992-1993 promedio):\n")
cat("   Media:", round(mean_val[,1], 6), "\n")
cat("   Mínimo:", round(min_val[,1], 6), "\n")
cat("   Máximo:", round(max_val[,1], 6), "\n")
cat("   NAs:", na_count[,1], "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 10. VISUALIZAR
# =============================================================================
plot(tree_mean, 
     main = "Tree PFT (1992-1993 promedio)",
     col = hcl.colors(100, "Greens", rev = TRUE))

```


```{r}
modern_pollen <- readRDS("H:/Mi unidad/Research/Final_LATAM_climate_reconstruction/Input_for_reconstruction/updated_modern_dataset_climate_hill.rds")
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# EXTRAER TREE PFT EN PUNTOS DE MUESTREO
# =============================================================================

# 1. Preparar puntos de muestreo
sampling_points <- modern_pollen %>%
  select(id_sample, latitude, longitude) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  distinct(id_sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 2. Crear matriz de coordenadas (longitud, latitud)
coords_matrix <- as.matrix(sampling_points[, c("longitude", "latitude")])

# 3. Extraer usando terra::extract()
tree_values <- terra::extract(tree_mean, coords_matrix)

# Extraer usando pluck (más seguro que índices)
tree_vector <- tree_values %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  pluck(1)  # Extrae la primera columna

# 5. Crear dataframe final
# IMPORTANTE: tree_values tiene dos columnas: ID y Tree
# Si solo tiene una columna, significa que no incluyó ID automáticamente
# En ese caso, la columna es directamente el valor de Tree

# Dado que tree_values tiene una sola columna, es directo:
resultados_tree <- sampling_points %>%
  mutate(Tree_PFT = tree_vector) %>%  # Usar corchetes
  left_join(modern_pollen, by=c("id_sample", "latitude", "longitude"))




plot_sampling <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_polyg, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(
    data = resultados_tree,
    aes(longitude, latitude, fill = Tree_PFT),
    size = 1.8,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = hcl.colors(100, "Greens", rev = TRUE),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Tree fraction"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

plot_sampling
```
